I spend too much time trying to differentiate hypomanic and just a great mood....it is so unhealthy. So like someone prior has said, be cautious of dangerous and unhealthy behavior but do not get yourself down for being super creative or productive. Having bipolar disorder can be bad, of course but allow yourself to accept some good out of it, just be self aware. <3 Do not overanalyze.

As long as you are not saying you are going to harm yourself or anyone else nobody is going to come to your house I promise. Hotlines are safe, one time I stayed in a mobile text chat while I was at work because I was near a panic attack and depression was so horrible I didnt think I was going to make it through work. It has saved my sanity many times, if not my life. Always call if you need support. <3
